resources.string: To scan for BitChat nodes and build the coverage map, the following permissions are required:
Required to search for BitChat devices via BLE service.

Required on every Android version. Android only delivers BLE scan results to this app while precise location is granted and Location Services are on. Coordinates are attached to detections made while the app is visible. Choose “Precise” in the system dialog.
If Android no longer shows the permission dialog, open the app settings and allow Nearby devices (Bluetooth) and precise Location.
Detection history is stored locally by this app and is not uploaded to an app backend. Opening the map downloads map tiles for the visible area from OpenStreetMap.

When the app is visible, scanning uses a low-latency callback. When you leave it, Android keeps a filtered, best-effort BLE PendingIntent subscription. The system may throttle it, delay results, or miss advertisements; background scanning is not continuous or guaranteed.
Bluetooth or precise location permission is missing
Location Services are off — Android does not deliver BLE scan results
Scanner error — press Start to retry
Notify about matching BitChat advertisements (with a cooldown). Android 13+ will ask for notification permission; declining keeps notifications off and does not stop scanning.
Notifications when a BitChat advertisement is detected.
